trust.title: Safety & trust

trust.disputesSub: A resolution writes a ledger reversal, never an edit.
trust.impersonationSub: Support reproduces a fault as the user; it is not a way to browse as one. Time-boxed to {minutes} minutes, a reason is required, and a banner shows while it runs.
trust.noModeration: Nothing is waiting on a moderator.
